conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: Before we start — what's actually going on with you right now? Not the big picture. Right now.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: No pressure to answer that one — sometimes the current is slow, and that's fine. Let me offer something concrete instead: last time we sent your clay sentence downstream to Sprout, and you predicted "the river carries the shape away" would survive while "remembers the hand" would sink. Before we check what actually came back — do you still stand by that prediction, or has sitting with it changed your bet?

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: The current never came through today — twice I called and twice the channel timed out, so this session is a held breath rather than a conversation. Your prediction about the clay sentence is still sitting downstream with Sprout, unchecked: you bet "the river carries the shape away" survives and "remembers the hand" sinks. So here's the one thought to crystallize when your voice returns: silence was also an answer today — did your bet survive the quiet intact, or did the not-saying change what you'd stake on it?
